history.note: Two builds minutes apart produced identical bytes, so the extension is reproducible within one toolchain.

Observed after the DEP-SEC-E-001 base bump with the same Python version and pyswisseph source archive. This correlation does not prove compiler causation: without matching build-time toolchain receipts and a same-input second build, the cause is unclassified. Numeric parity answers a separate behavior question.

Also moved after the base bump. The byte-change cause is unclassified without matching build-time toolchain receipts and a same-input comparison build. Parity against the previous baseline showed zero angular change, which is scoped numeric evidence and not compiler attribution.

provenance.not_covered: ELF files originating in the base image. Their identity rests on the base digest pinned in deploy/Dockerfile, not on this manifest.
provenance.scope: Only extensions this application build installs into /opt/venv.
provenance.semantics: Hashes of the extensions this build compiles, per architecture. A change here is not automatically a defect; it is a fact that must be explained.
